g.text: MINERVA PUBLIC NOTICE · Curfew 22:00–05:00 · Block 7: violence high, security response limited · Pilot program hiring

svg.text: 23:41 · Curfew: violence high, security response limited · Block 7 · Unit 7-2216
Here a menu belongs: tabs 1–4, shoulder buttons · ✕, Esc or B shrinks it back into the screen
From far away her screen is just her emblem. Click
it and the camera pushes in; the console lifts off
the screen and squares up to you, the room still
behind it. Menus live here, not in the world.
Her buttons are the card drawer’s (the ones that
slide out from behind the selection card): plum
pills with their picture in a round well. The one
you’re on lights its edge and gets the focus ring.
